purpose: Controlled root-chart algorithm comparison; this is not an end-to-end five-point speedup claim.
comparison_rule: abs(new-old) < 10^-50 * max(1,abs(old)) for every retained coefficient, including constant; both algorithms start from the same selected numerical negative root.
new_algorithm: Compiled once: diagonal rational system r_i_prime = (R_i_prime/(2 R_i)) r_i; existing CompiledSystem::taylor with finite polynomial denominator recurrence.
reference_algorithm: Native Symbolica exact AtomField series of R(x)/R(center), raised to 1/2 by native rpow, then evaluated at fixed MPFR precision and multiplied by the selected root.
preserved_checks: midpoint and endpoint root truncation and differential defects
shared solution midpoint/endpoint defects and tail checks

test_environment.dependencies: existing release-built native Symbolica and library dependencies

validation.includes: ordinary winding and independent precision/order refinement; direct epsilon hierarchy; concurrent opposite sheets; two-root products; rejection nonmutation; sparse-root defects; multivariate dlog and stationary-path domain checks; fixed-series arithmetic guards
